sloka: सा विसृष्टभुजा भीमा पपात लवणाम्भसि ।मया पर्वतसङ्काशा निकृत्तहृदया सती ।। ५.५८.४३ ।।।।
transliteration: sā visṛṣṭabhujā bhīmā papāta lavaṇāmbhasi ।mayā parvatasaṅkāśā nikṛttahṛdayā satī ।। 5.58.43 ।।।।

translations.english: "She who resembled a mountain fell into the ocean with her arms hanging down when I pulled out her heart.
